title: A/R Summary: the Totals row leaves out overpaid invoices, as the rows do
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an invoice {Invoice-A} of $100.00 paid $120.00 (overpaid), and an open invoice {Invoice-B} of $500.00 on today's date.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-13 Overpaid.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Summary is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the Customer filter showing only {Customer-A} ticked.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Read {Customer-A}'s row.
  2. Read the Totals row.
  3. Compare the Totals row with the row above it, column by column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the row counts only {Invoice-B}: Total $500.00; the overpaid invoice is not in the row.
  • Step 2: the Totals row's Total reads $500.00.
  • Step 3: every column of the Totals row equals {Customer-A}'s row: the Totals row adds up exactly the rows above it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • What changes for existing users: “The A/R Summary Totals row now adds up exactly the customer rows above it. Today it also counts overpaid invoices (an invoice paid for more than its amount), which the rows don't, so for those customers the Totals don't match the rows. Production has 16 such invoices across 13 customer accounts; their A/R Summary Totals will differ slightly from today. The rows themselves don't change.”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”
